text: Implemented PlotCompiler.scala with TrainedPlot, ResolvedLayer, ResolvedRow, DroppedRow, PlotDropReason, and compile/resolve APIs for point/line/text layers. Added PlotCompilerSuite coverage for scaled/direct/constant resolution, non-finite row drops, scaled label drops, empty layer data, and unsupported geom errors. Verified: sbt graphicsJVM/test graphicsJS/test graphicsSvgJVM/test graphicsSvgJS/test.
